description: DISCOURSE COHERENCE = COLLAPSE OVER A COHERENCE-RELATION CODEBOOK, one level up from reading_collapse's clause-construction codebook (a span-pair is decoded the same way a clause is: recognised markers -> skeleton -> ShapeDecode against held ShapeSignatureCoherence nodes, kept in their OWN codebook_type so they never compete with the clause-construction ShapeSignature pool). Two triggers feed the skeleton: (1) MARKED -- a discourse connective leading the second span, recognised via new MarkerClass discourse-cue classes (DISC_CONTRAST/DISC_CAUSE/DISC_SEQUENCE/DISC_CONDITION) using the SAME marker-lexicon mechanism reading_collapse's clause markers use; (2) UNMARKED -- a situation-model-style signal computed from the two spans' own grounded predications: shared entity (continuity, Centering Theory's 'preserved center'), spanA's verb a change-of-state (COS class, reused as-is from situation_model_reader.cos_membership) or spanB's verb a TELIC_RESULT (achievement) verb, or spanB itself a property-description construction (elaboration). Both paths mint the SAME token vocabulary (DISC_* or SM_*) that the decode reads -- the RELATION ITSELF is always ShapeDecode's verdict (the winning ShapeSignatureCoherence's `relation` attr), never a Python if/else naming the relation directly.

microtheory.name: coherence_relations
microtheory.description: RST-style coherence relations (elaboration/contrast/cause/sequence/condition) between adjacent spans, decoded by ShapeDecode over a dedicated ShapeSignatureCoherence codebook; marked (discourse connective) and unmarked (situation-model-style entity/verb-class signal) triggers feed the SAME decode.

attrs.note: Discourse-level CONTRAST connective, checked at the LEADING position of the second span only (a mid-span 'but' is ordinary clause-internal coordination, out of scope here).
Discourse-level CAUSE/RESULT connective, checked at the LEADING position of the second span.
Discourse-level TEMPORAL-SEQUENCE connective, checked at the LEADING position of the second span.

Discourse-level CONDITION connective distinct from the existing clause-level IF class ('unless' has no within-clause IF/THEN counterpart). A leading 'if' is read via the EXISTING IF MarkerClass (seeds/reading_constructions.json) -- reused as-is, not duplicated here.

ACHIEVEMENT/TELIC-RESULT marker-class (the UNMARKED-cause signal's second leg, mirroring COS/DESIGNATE/POSSESS): a verb naming the attainment of a goal. The seed forms cover the common case directly (no adjacency gamble needed for the gate's own examples); a NEW surface verb (accomplishes/prevails/triumphs/...) JOINS by the SAME WordNet path-similarity adjacency mechanism reading_collapse._wordnet_nearness/_compute_adjacency already implements over ANY MarkerClass declaring adjacency_anchor -- reused as-is, no new adjacency code. When spanB's main verb is a member of this class AND the two spans share an entity, the unmarked signal reads SM_CAUSE (the achievement is caused by whatever the shared-entity's prior span did), the situation-model twin of situation_model_reader's COS-triggered SM_CAUSE leg (a physical change of state).

attrs.name: condition_if
attrs.note: Signature reuses the EXISTING clause-level IF MarkerClass token ('if' leading the second span) -- not a new marker.

attrs.name: cause_unmarked
attrs.note: UNMARKED cause: fires when the situation-model-style signal (shared entity + spanA change-of-state (COS) or spanB telic-result verb) is present with no discourse connective. Same relation name as cause_marked -- proves marked/unmarked convergence, not marker-regex.

attrs.name: sequence_unmarked
attrs.note: UNMARKED sequence: shared entity (continuity) with no stronger cue and no discourse connective -- the weakest positive signal (temporal succession over a persisting participant).

attrs.name: elaboration_unmarked
attrs.note: UNMARKED elaboration: spanB is a property-description construction (definitional/attributive/possession/designation) about an entity spanA already introduced -- more detail about the SAME thing, not a new event. HONEST: the least reliably triggered relation of the five (needs the property-construction signal to line up); included for RST coverage, not exercised by a dedicated gate example.
